name: Add Capability
description: A new business-meaningful capability was introduced.

name: Remove Capability
description: An existing business-meaningful capability was removed.

name: Modify Capability
description: An existing capability's behavior changed without being added or removed.

name: Move Responsibility
description: A responsibility moved from one type/module to another.

name: Capability Extraction
description: Multiple responsibilities moved from the same source module to the same destination module, extracting a new capability.

name: Split Responsibility
description: One type/module's responsibility was divided across multiple types/modules.

name: Merge Responsibility
description: Multiple types'/modules' responsibilities were consolidated into one.

name: Introduce Abstraction
description: A new interface or abstract type was introduced above existing implementation(s).

name: Remove Abstraction
description: An interface or abstract type was collapsed back into a concrete implementation.

name: Change Collaboration
description: Which types collaborate, or how, changed without changing what either does alone.

name: Change State Management
description: How state is held or mutated changed (e.g. mutable to immutable, in-memory to persisted).

name: Change Data Ownership
description: Which type/module is authoritative for a piece of data changed.

name: Change API Responsibility
description: What a public API is responsible for doing changed.
